title: Sokaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Mon Mayuree
desc: Priyo, a poor orphan, secures a job through his mentor Sunil Da. Meanwhile, he falls for his boss's daughter, but a child calling him father sparks trouble.

title: Mayer Adhikar
desc: Joy falls for Asha after she helps him recover from a mysterious accident.

title: Porinaam
desc: Raghu falls in love with Nisha, but her father opposes their union. To gain his approval, Raghu decides to enter her house disguised as a servant.

title: Annaye Atyachar
desc: An inebriated Udayan spends a night with his friend's daughter, Kunti, mistaking her to be his wife. He leaves unaware the next morning, setting off a chain of chaotic events.

title: Pooja
desc: A maidservant witnesses the horrific tortures subjected to her employer's daughter by her in-laws. Eventually, she hatches a plot to infiltrate the house and rescue her mistress.

title: Marjina Abdullah
desc: A man discovers a cave filled with stolen treasures and takes some for himself. However, things take a turn when the robbers start looking for their missing loot.

title: Paka Dekha
desc: Aparna's father, an officer, fixes her marriage with the man of his choice. Disappointed with this, she runs away, after which, her father arrests four of her friends and begins interrogating them.

title: Shrimati
desc: Shrimati, a middle-class homemaker, decides to reclaim her life after almost losing her own identity to insecurities while chasing high-society status.

title: Patanjali Yog - By Yogrishi Swami Ramdev
desc: Baba Ramdev emphasises the importance of yoga and demonstrates various asanas and breathing exercises that enable one to lead a healthy and stress-free life.

title: Tomai Pabo Bole
desc: Two neighbouring families are embroiled in a bitter rivalry. However, in an interesting turn of events, the son of one family falls in love with the daughter of the other.

title: Basanta Bilap
desc: Shyam's life turns upside down when conflicts brew within his friend group. Later, while his friends find comfort in love, Shyam struggles silently, unable to reveal his true feelings to Anu.
